title: WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing
abstract: arXiv:2610.00713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.

translated_title: WOMBAT：用于分子基准测试与归因测试的白盒预言机
translated_abstract: 当图神经网络（GNN）解释器对某个分子产生意外的归因结果时，仅凭归因本身无法判断究竟是解释器失效了，还是模型学到了捷径。我们提出了WOMBAT，这是一个由14个白盒GNN组成的基准测试集，每个模型的消息传递权重均为手工设置，用于检测特定的SMARTS基序。每个模型的决策规则在构建时就已知晓，从而提供了归因的真值标准，可据此识别和研究解释器的错误。我们在数百万个PubChem分子上验证了这些模型，并评估了包括GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients在内的事后解释器。在我们的定性分析指导下，我们构建了一个模型，该模型能使Integrated Gradients将归因分散到整个图上，尽管该模型本身能够可靠地检测到预期的基序。我们发布了数据集、模型和评估代码，以帮助研究人员开发更新的GNN可解释AI（XAI）工具。
tldr: WOMBAT通过14个手工设置权重的白盒GNN提供归因真值，为GNN解释器的错误识别与诊断建立了首个可控基准测试。
en_tdlr: WOMBAT establishes the first controlled benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs with hand-set weights, providing attribution ground truth for identifying and diagnosing GNN explainer errors.
